limits: Census counts eligibility, not encounter frequency. Six-second fixtures isolate a single hungry hunter and straight swimming. Neither establishes the original game numerical constants or child play feel.

exploration.method: 55 species × three seeds × 600 seconds. Regular food below 65 energy, parasite cleaning above 35 damage, normal travel; no defensive abilities or deliberate predator avoidance; initial protection disabled. Seed 42 reuses prior report with identical simulation rules; seeds 7 and 91 were rerun for this audit. Rounded chase time samples post-step and misses immediate bites. This is not a child playtest.
